messages.subject: Executive interest | Strategic partnerships, ESG and government relations
messages.body:
Dear Siam Piwat Talent Acquisition Team,

Siam Piwat’s destination portfolio sits at the intersection of global partnerships, public-private collaboration, sustainability, community experience and long-term place value. That combination closely matches the stakeholder environments where I add the most value.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit covers government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination, strategic partnerships and executive stakeholder strategy across a major international investment and operating environment.

I would bring Siam Piwat a structured approach to institutional engagement, partner alignment and reputation-sensitive execution. I regularly coordinate ministries, regulators, communities, contractors and internal teams, translating external commitments into accountable actions. My experience also includes sustainability and energy-transition work, giving me a strong basis for supporting destination growth where commercial objectives, public stakeholders and ESG priorities need to move together.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles across Strategic Partnerships, Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Sustainability, ESG, Stakeholder Strategy or related executive mandates. I have attached a Siam Piwat-focused executive CV and am available on a 30-day notice period.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
